title: VAT matrix recreate route decision after D15 no-write diagnosis
purpose: Review D14/D15 screenshots, Page Inspection field facts and Microsoft Learn VAT setup source before choosing any future VAT matrix write route.
acceptanceCriteria: D16 selects exactly one non-repeating route for the next VAT matrix write or explicitly parks VAT matrix setup.
D16 explains why Bearbeiten/list route and blind grid typing are insufficient.
D16 may create a future write case only if it has a concrete field/control route and stop condition.

nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Before any further VAT setup write, the UI route must distinguish rowheader/header/display cells from real editable controls.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: The next step should be a local/source/UI route decision, not another blind list-cell write.

Do not claim VAT setup or final German VAT correctness.
